meta_description: Letters of Love is how our girls give back: handmade cards for girls going through things, and community events like our bake sale.
hero_text: This is how our girls give back to the community. We make handmade cards for girls who are going through things, and we host events to bring people together for good.
intro_heading: Handmade cards for girls going through things
intro_text: Our girls make handmade cards for other girls who are going through things. A few warm words and a drawing can make someone feel less alone, and that is something we know a lot about.

photos.alt: Nine handmade cards spread on a table: a smiling sun, planets, a ghost, a heart, a pickle, a cereal spoon, a carrot, a rock and peaches
photos.caption: Our latest batch: sunshine, carrots, peaches and more, ready to deliver

photos.alt: A girl coloring yellow suns on a handmade card with markers
photos.caption: Coloring suns on a handmade card

steps.title: Gather
steps.text: Girls get together, in person or online, with paper, markers, and stickers.

steps.title: Make
steps.text: Each girl makes a card by hand. A drawing, a favorite quote, or a wish for a better day all work. We sign with first names only.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.text: We collect the cards and pass them on to girls who could use a little encouragement.
